item.title: This Week in Spring - September 1st, 2026
item.dc:creator: joshlong
item.content:encoded:
Hi, Spring fans! Welcome to another exciting installment of This Week in Spring! I'm writing this from lovely Oslo, Norway, for the joyous JavaZone conference. Next, I'm going to Amsterdam for the interesting IntelliJ IDEA conference, and then finally it's off to Kansas City for the kinetic KCDC show! It's a conference rush, and I'm 100% here for it. I'm also here for the amazing community, whose vibrant, endless feed of content sustains me and this very roundup. So, without further ado, let's dive right in.

  • I thought this was a very nicely done chart. I don't know that I agree with all of the prescriptions or the timelines, but I do love it as a first cut as a guide to concepts to learn to learn "Spring."
  • this is an interesting comparison looking at the difference between Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ.
  • Spring Modulith 2.2.M1, 2.1.1, 2.0.8, and 1.4.13 are released
  • a few weeks ago I started a series on building multitenant systems with Spring Security, OAuth, and the Arconia multitenancy modules
  • I continued that series, showing how to carve up data in a multitenant system, in this video
  • in last week's installment of A Bootiful Podcast, I chatted with my friend Joe Grandja, guru on all things Spring Security and OAuth
  • a nice writeup from Rodolfo Mendes on a session by Yuriy Bezsonov on building Spring AI-powered AI agents.
  • Baeldung has a nice post on using Anthropics' Claude models with Spring AI
  • and yet another amazing installment of Craig Walls' Spring AI recipes - this one looking at efficient tool reuse
  • and yet another amazing installment, again, of Craig Walls' Spring AI recipes on how to get better search results with Spring AI and hybrid search
  • and another still! This one on better RAG results with re-ranking in Spring AI
  • just when you thought I was done with Craig's amazing content... another one! This one on better RAG results with hypothetical document embeddings

item.title: Spring Office Hours Podcast: S5E21 - Pro Spring Boot 4 with Felipe Gutierrez
item.dc:creator: danvega
item.content:encoded:
Join Dan Vega and DaShaun Carter for the latest updates from the Spring Ecosystem. In this episode, Dan and DaShaun are joined by returning guest Felipe Gutierrez, co-author with DaShaun of the new book "Pro Spring Boot 4: An Authoritative Guide with Best Practices" from Apress. Felipe and DaShaun discuss what it was like writing the book together and what readers can expect, including Spring Boot 4, Spring Security, GraalVM native compilation, AOT, Testcontainers, and building intelligent applications with Spring AI. You can participate in our live stream to ask questions or catch the replay on your preferred podcast platform.

Show Notes

  • Pro Spring Boot 4

item.title: Spring Modulith 2.2 M1, 2.1.1, 2.0.8, and 1.4.13 released
item.dc:creator: odrotbohm
item.content:encoded:
On behalf of the community, I am happy to announce the availability of Spring Modulith 2.2 M1, 2.1.1, 2.0.8, and 1.4.13. The bug fix releases primarily ship the usual dependency upgrades. The first milestone of 2.2 moves to Spring Boot 4.2 M1 (GH-1799) and Spring Framework 7.1 M1 (GH-1798), alongside a couple of minor bug fixes and improvements around the Namastack Outbox integration and auto-configuration registration that have been ported back if applicable.

Find more details about the releases in the full changelog for 2.2 M1, 2.1.1, 2.0.8, and 1.4.13.
